title: Configuration Update from a Selector
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean string, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$. A selector specifying a work tape $h$ and direction $d$ changes only that work tape's head position, by adding $d$; a selector specifying the input tape and direction $d$ changes only the input-head position by one step in direction $d$. A selector specifying a state leaves the configuration unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A selector, which is either a state selector or a tape-and-direction selector
